Definition: to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bare, polish, make smooth or bald or bare; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to make bare; 1a2) to scour, polish; 1b) (Niphal) to be made bald
